descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un team manager di ricerca e sviluppo esperto e motivato per guidare il nostro team di Next Generation Grids Transformers a Ginevra, Svizzera. In questo ruolo, gestirai un team di oltre 5 ingegneri e guiderai lo sviluppo di tecnologie avanzate e innovative, inclusi trasformatori di media frequenza e trasformatori potenziati per l'elettronica di potenza. Combinerai la leadership delle persone con una forte guida tecnica e proprietà del progetto, contribuendo all'attuazione della strategia di ricerca e sviluppo in un ambiente globale. Come avrai un impatto Guidare, sviluppare e motivare un team internazionale di ricerca e sviluppo composto da oltre 5 ingegneri con know-how nei trasformatori di media frequenza, convertitori di potenza e test di laboratorio Fornire leadership tecnica e supportare il team nella risoluzione di sfide ingegneristiche complesse Contribuire alla strategia di ricerca e sviluppo e alla direzione tecnologica, compreso lo sviluppo di roadmap per la linea di prodotti New Generation Grids Transformers Pianificare, guidare e fornire progetti di ricerca e sviluppo, garantendo l'allineamento con l'ambito, le tempistiche e gli obiettivi di qualità Collaborare strettamente con la ricerca e sviluppo globale team, funzioni di ingegneria e partner esterni Gestire le risorse e i budget del progetto per massimizzare l'impatto e l'efficienza operativa Responsabilità del laboratorio di ricerca e sviluppo del sito e delle infrastrutture, inclusa la guida dei piani di espansione Introdurre e implementare nuovi strumenti, tecnologie e processi per migliorare le prestazioni Il tuo background Master o dottorato di ricerca in ingegneria elettrica o campo correlato Diversi anni di esperienza industriale nello sviluppo di prodotti o nella gestione della tecnologia Forte background tecnico in trasformatori e convertitori di potenza Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di progetti nell'ambito di ricerca e sviluppo o sviluppo di prodotti Esperienza nella guida di team tecnici (leadership di linea o di progetto) e di lavoro in ambienti internazionali e interfunzionali Forti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (il francese è un vantaggio) e capacità di coinvolgimento delle parti interessate. Maggiori informazioni su di noi Entrerai a far parte di un ambiente di ricerca e sviluppo collaborativo e internazionale in prima linea nelle tecnologie di rete di prossima generazione. Lavorando a Ginevra, contribuirai a soluzioni innovative di trasformatori che supportano la transizione energetica e lo sviluppo di sistemi energetici più flessibili e sostenibili. Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking an experienced and motivated R&D Team Manager to lead our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva, Switzerland. In this role, you will manage a team of 5+ engineers and drive the development of advanced and innovative technologies, including medium frequency transformers and power electronics enhanced transformers. You will combine people leadership with strong technical guidance and project ownership, contributing to the execution of R&D strategy in a global environment. How you'll make an impact Lead, develop, and motivate an international R&D team of 5+ engineers with know-how in medium frequency transformers, power converters and lab testing Provide technical leadership and support the team in solving complex engineering challenges Contribute to R&D strategy and technology direction, including development of roadmaps for the New Generation Grids Transformers product line Plan, drive, and deliver R&D projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and quality targets Collaborate closely with global R&D teams, engineering functions, and external partners Manage project resources and budgets to maximize impact and operational efficiency Site R&D laboratory and infrastructure responsibility, including driving expansion plans Introduce and implement new tools, technologies, and processes to improve performance Your background Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related field Several years of industrial experience in product development, or technology management Strong technical background in transformers and power converters Proven experience in project management within R&D or product development Experience in leading technical teams (line or project leadership) and working in international and cross-functional environments Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) as well as stakeholder engagement capabilities More about us You will join a collaborative and international R&D environment at the forefront of next-generation grid technologies. Working in Geneva, you will contribute to innovative transformer solutions that support the energy transition and the development of more flexible and sustainable power systems. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit: Hitachi Energy sucht einen erfahrenen und motivierten F&E-Teammanager zur Leitung unseres Next Generation Grids Transformers-Teams in Genf, Schweiz. In dieser Rolle leiten Sie ein Team von mehr als 5 Ingenieuren und treiben die Entwicklung fortschrittlicher und innovativer Technologien voran, darunter Mittelfrequenztransformatoren und Transformatoren mit Leistungselektronik. Sie kombinieren Personalführung mit starker technischer Führung und Projektverantwortung und tragen so zur Umsetzung der F&E-Strategie in einem globalen Umfeld bei. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden: Führen, entwickeln und motivieren Sie ein internationales F&E-Team aus mehr als 5 Ingenieuren mit Know-how in Mittelfrequenztransformatoren, Leistungswandlern und Labortests. Übernehmen Sie technische Führung und unterstützen Sie das Team bei der Lösung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen. Tragen Sie zur F&E-Strategie und Technologieausrichtung bei, einschließlich der Entwicklung von Roadmaps für die Produktlinie „New Generation Grids Transformers“. Technische Funktionen und externe Partner Verwalten Sie Projektressourcen und -budgets, um die Wirkung und betriebliche Effizienz zu maximieren. Verantwortung für F&E-Labor und Infrastruktur vor Ort, einschließlich der Förderung von Expansionsplänen. Einführung und Implementierung neuer Werkzeuge, Technologien und Prozesse zur Verbesserung der Leistung. Ihr Hintergrund. Master- oder Doktortitel in Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich. Mehrjährige Industrieerfahrung in der Produktentwicklung oder im Technologiemanagement. Ausgeprägte technische Erfahrung in Transformatoren und Stromrichtern. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Projektmanagement in der Forschung und Entwicklung oder Produktentwicklung. Erfahrung in der Leitung technischer Teams (Linien- oder Projektleitung) und in der Arbeit in internationalen und funktionsübergreifenden Umgebungen. Stark Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (Französisch ist ein Plus) sowie Fähigkeiten zur Einbindung von Stakeholdern. Mehr über uns: Sie werden Teil einer kollaborativen und internationalen Forschungs- und Entwicklungsumgebung an der Spitze der Netztechnologien der nächsten Generation. Bei Ihrer Arbeit in Genf tragen Sie zu innovativen Transformatorlösungen bei, die die Energiewende und die Entwicklung flexiblerer und nachhaltigerer Energiesysteme unterstützen. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy est à la recherche d'un chef d'équipe R&D expérimenté et motivé pour diriger notre équipe de transformateurs de réseaux de nouvelle génération à Genève, en Suisse. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez une équipe de plus de 5 ingénieurs et piloterez le développement de technologies avancées et innovantes, notamment des transformateurs moyenne fréquence et des transformateurs améliorés en électronique de puissance. Vous combinerez le leadership des personnes avec de solides conseils techniques et la propriété du projet, contribuant ainsi à l'exécution de la stratégie de R&D dans un environnement mondial. Comment vous aurez un impact Diriger, développer et motiver une équipe R&D internationale de plus de 5 ingénieurs possédant un savoir-faire en matière de transformateurs moyenne fréquence, de convertisseurs de puissance et de tests en laboratoire Assurer un leadership technique et soutenir l'équipe dans la résolution de défis d'ingénierie complexes Contribuer à la stratégie de R&D et à l'orientation technologique, y compris l'élaboration de feuilles de route pour la gamme de produits Transformateurs de réseaux de nouvelle génération Planifier, conduire et réaliser des projets de R&D, en garantissant l'alignement avec la portée, les délais et les objectifs de qualité Collaborer étroitement avec la R&D mondiale équipes, fonctions d'ingénierie et partenaires externes Gérer les ressources et les budgets du projet pour maximiser l'impact et l'efficacité opérationnelle Responsabilité du laboratoire et de l'infrastructure de R&D du site, y compris la conduite des plans d'expansion Introduire et mettre en œuvre de nouveaux outils, technologies et processus pour améliorer les performances. compétences en communication en anglais (le français est un plus) ainsi que des capacités d'engagement des parties prenantes. En savoir plus sur nous Vous rejoindrez un environnement de R&D collaboratif et international à la pointe des technologies de réseau de nouvelle génération. En travaillant à Genève, vous contribuerez à des solutions de transformateurs innovantes qui soutiennent la transition énergétique et le développement de systèmes électriques plus flexibles et durables. Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement dans lequel tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et évoluer.

jobs.title: Designer Bushings 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Join a dynamic team at the forefront of high-voltage technology, where your creativity and precision will shape the future of custom-engineered bushings. As a Designer, you'll take ownership of innovative mechanical solutions, optimize designs for performance and manufacturability, and contribute directly to cutting-edge development projects. This is your chance to work hands-on with advanced tools like Creo and SAP, while driving continuous improvement in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment. If you're passionate about engineering excellence and ready to make a tangible impact, this role is made for you. How you'll make an impact Development and design of customer-specific high-voltage bushings Maintenance and creation of technical documentation, bills of materials, and master data in the SAP system Implementation of technical specifications and application of dimensional, form, and positional tolerances Optimization of existing designs with regard to efficiency, manufacturability, and quality Independent execution of smaller development projects or tool improvements Support in the continuous improvement of our processes and products Your background Completed training as a design engineer (EFZ) or a comparable qualification 3 to 5 years of professional experience in mechanical design or product design Solid knowledge of 3D design, ideally with Creo (PTC) Independent, reliable, and solution-oriented working style High level of initiative and sense of responsibility Very good German skills, both written and spoken; English skills are an advantage More about us   Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Unisciti a un team dinamico all'avanguardia nella tecnologia dell'alta tensione, dove la tua creatività e precisione daranno forma al futuro delle boccole progettate su misura. In qualità di progettista, sarai proprietario di soluzioni meccaniche innovative, ottimizzerai i progetti in termini di prestazioni e producibilità e contribuirai direttamente a progetti di sviluppo all'avanguardia. Questa è la tua occasione per lavorare direttamente con strumenti avanzati come Creo e SAP, promuovendo al contempo il miglioramento continuo in un ambiente collaborativo e lungimirante. Se sei appassionato dell'eccellenza ingegneristica e sei pronto ad avere un impatto tangibile, questo ruolo è fatto per te. Come avrai un impatto Sviluppo e progettazione di passanti ad alta tensione specifici per il cliente Manutenzione e creazione di documentazione tecnica, distinte materiali e dati anagrafici nel sistema SAP Implementazione di specifiche tecniche e applicazione di tolleranze dimensionali, di forma e di posizione Ottimizzazione dei progetti esistenti per quanto riguarda efficienza, producibilità e qualità Esecuzione indipendente di piccoli progetti di sviluppo o miglioramenti degli strumenti Supporto nel miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi e prodotti Il tuo background Formazione completata come ingegnere progettista (EFZ) o qualifica comparabile Da 3 a 5 anni di esperienza professionale nella progettazione meccanica o nella progettazione di prodotti Solida conoscenza della progettazione 3D, idealmente con Creo (PTC) Stile di lavoro indipendente, affidabile e orientato alla soluzione Alto livello di iniziativa e senso di responsabilità Ottime competenze in tedesco, sia scritto che parlato; La conoscenza dell'inglese è un vantaggio Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit: Werden Sie Teil eines dynamischen Teams an der Spitze der Hochspannungstechnologie, in dem Ihre Kreativität und Präzision die Zukunft kundenspezifischer Durchführungen gestalten werden. Als Designer übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für innovative mechanische Lösungen, optimieren Designs hinsichtlich Leistung und Herstellbarkeit und tragen direkt zu hochmodernen Entwicklungsprojekten bei. Dies ist Ihre Chance, praxisnah mit fortschrittlichen Tools wie Creo und SAP zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig in einer kollaborativen, zukunftsorientierten Umgebung kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für technische Exzellenz haben und bereit sind, spürbare Veränderungen zu bewirken, ist diese Stelle genau das Richtige für Sie. Wie Sie etwas bewegen können Entwicklung und Konstruktion von kundenspezifischen Hochspannungsdurchführungen Pflege und Erstellung von technischen Dokumentationen, Stücklisten und Stammdaten im SAP-System Umsetzung technischer Spezifikationen und Anwendung von Maß-, Form- und Lagetoleranzen Optimierung bestehender Konstruktionen hinsichtlich Effizienz, Herstellbarkeit und Qualität Selbstständige Durchführung kleinerer Entwicklungsprojekte oder Werkzeugverbesserungen Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse und Produkte Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Konstrukteur (EFZ) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der mechanischen Konstruktion oder im Produktdesign. Fundierte Kenntnisse im 3D-Design, idealerweise mit Creo (PTC). Selbständiger, zuverlässiger und lösungsorientierter Arbeitsstil. Hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Mehr über uns. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Rejoignez une équipe dynamique à la pointe de la technologie haute tension, où votre créativité et votre précision façonneront l'avenir des traversées sur mesure. En tant que concepteur, vous vous approprierez des solutions mécaniques innovantes, optimiserez les conceptions en termes de performances et de fabricabilité et contribuerez directement aux projets de développement de pointe. C'est votre chance de travailler concrètement avec des outils avancés tels que Creo et SAP, tout en favorisant une amélioration continue dans un environnement collaboratif et avant-gardiste. Si vous êtes passionné par l'excellence en ingénierie et prêt à avoir un impact tangible, ce poste est fait pour vous. Comment vous aurez un impact Développement et conception de traversées haute tension spécifiques au client Maintenance et création de documentation technique, de nomenclatures et de données de base dans le système SAP Mise en œuvre des spécifications techniques et application des tolérances dimensionnelles, de forme et de position Optimisation des conceptions existantes en termes d'efficacité, de fabricabilité et de qualité Exécution indépendante de petits projets de développement ou d'améliorations d'outils Soutien à l'amélioration continue de nos processus et produits Votre parcours Une formation terminée en tant qu'ingénieur de conception (EFZ) ou une qualification comparable 3 à 5 années d'expérience professionnelle en conception mécanique ou en conception de produits Solides connaissances en conception 3D, idéalement avec Creo (PTC) Style de travail indépendant, fiable et orienté solutions Haut niveau d'initiative et sens des responsabilités Très bonnes compétences en allemand, tant écrit qu'oral ; Les compétences en anglais sont un avantage. En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte aktiv die Zukunft mit – dort, wo Sicherheit und Innovation aufeinandertreffen. Wir suchen eine engagierte und fachkompetente Umweltspezialistin bzw. einen engagierten und fachkompetenten Umweltspezialisten, die\/der unser Bestreben nach einem sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsumfeld weiter stärkt. In dieser zentralen Funktion verantwortest du Initiativen zum Schutz unserer Mitarbeitenden, stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Vorschriften sicher und förderst eine proaktive Sicherheits- und Umweltkultur im gesamten Unternehmen. Das kannst du bewirken Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie interner Richtlinien Durchführen von Risiko‑, Gefahren‑ und Umweltanalysen inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Planen und Durchführen von internen Audits, Begehungen und Umweltkontrollen Untersuchen von Unfällen und Ereignissen sowie Erarbeitung von Präventionsmassnahmen Mitarbeit an Nachhaltigkeit‑ und Umweltprojekten sowie Förderung der Umweltkultur Erstellen und Durchführen von Schulungen zu Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsrelevanten Themen Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Projektteams bei HSE‑Fragestellungen Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Auditoren und externen Partnern Das bringst du mit Abschluss in Umweltwissenschaften, Umwelttechnik, Arbeitssicherheit oder einem vergleichbaren technischen\/naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (FH\/Universität) Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im HSE oder Umweltbereich, idealerweise in Industrie, Produktion oder technischen Organisationen Fundierte Kenntnisse der Schweizer Arbeitssicherheits- und Umweltgesetzgebung, inklusive relevanter Verordnungen (z. B. Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sulla posizione Plasma attivamente il futuro: dove sicurezza e innovazione si incontrano.
• Cerchiamo uno specialista ambientale impegnato e competente che rafforzerà ulteriormente il nostro impegno per un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, sano e sostenibile. In questo ruolo centrale, sarai responsabile di iniziative volte a proteggere i nostri dipendenti, garantire il rispetto delle normative pertinenti e promuovere una cultura proattiva della sicurezza e dell'ambiente in tutta l'azienda. Questo è quello che puoi fare: Garantire il rispetto delle normative ambientali e di sicurezza e delle linee guida interne Effettuare analisi di rischi, pericoli e ambientali, compresa la derivazione di misure Pianificare ed eseguire audit interni, ispezioni e controlli ambientali Indagare su incidenti ed eventi e sviluppare misure preventive Lavorare su progetti ambientali e di sostenibilità, nonché promuovere la cultura ambientale Creare e svolgere formazione su temi legati all'ambiente e alla sicurezza Consigliare e supportare manager e... Team di progetto su questioni HSE Collaborazione con autorità, revisori e partner esterni Questo è ciò che puoi fare con una laurea in scienze ambientali, tecnologie ambientali, sicurezza sul lavoro o un settore tecnico-scientifico comparabile (Scienze professionali/Università) Esperienza professionale pluriennale nel settore HSE o ambientale, preferibilmente in organizzazioni industriali, produttive o tecniche Conoscenza approfondita della legislazione svizzera in materia di sicurezza sul lavoro e ambientale, comprese le norme pertinenti (ad es. norme sugli incidenti rilevanti, legge sui prodotti chimici, legge sulla protezione dell'ambiente) Esperienza nell'esecuzione di analisi dei rischi, indagini sui pericoli e chiarimenti su incidenti ed eventi, inclusa la derivazione di misure Pratica nella pianificazione, attuazione e follow-up di audit, ispezioni e ispezioni interne, preferibilmente in conformità con ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 Forti capacità di comunicazione e consulenza per supportare manager, project manager e dipendenti in questioni HSE Capacità di creare e realizzare corsi di formazione su sicurezza sul lavoro, ambiente e sostenibilità, nonché capacità analitiche ed esperienza nel trattare con figure chiave HSE, reporting e miglioramento continuo Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese, altre lingue nazionali sono un vantaggio Maggiori informazioni su di noi I nostri modelli di lavoro flessibili vi aiutano a ottimizzare il personale e prestazioni professionali e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possano sviluppare ulteriormente le proprie competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: About the position Actively shape the future – where security and innovation meet. We are looking for a committed and competent environmental specialist who will further strengthen our commitment to a safe, healthy and sustainable working environment. In this central role, you will be responsible for initiatives to protect our employees, ensure compliance with relevant regulations and promote a proactive safety and environmental culture across the company. This is what you can do: Ensuring compliance with environmental and safety regulations and internal guidelines Carrying out risk, hazard and environmental analyzes including the derivation of measures Planning and carrying out internal audits, inspections and environmental controls Investigating accidents and events and developing preventive measures Working on sustainability and environmental projects as well as promoting environmental culture Creating and carrying out training on environmental and safety-related topics Advising and supporting managers and... Project teams on HSE issues Collaboration with authorities, auditors and external partners This is what you bring with a degree in environmental sciences, environmental technology, occupational safety or a comparable technical/scientific field (university of applied sciences/university) Several years of professional experience in the HSE or environmental sector, ideally in industry, production or technical organizations Sound knowledge of Swiss occupational safety and environmental legislation, including relevant regulations (e.g. major accident regulations, chemicals law, environmental protection law) Experience in carrying out risk analyses, Hazard investigations as well as accident and event clarifications, including the derivation of measures Practice in the planning, implementation and follow-up of audits, inspections and internal inspections, ideally in accordance with ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 Strong communication and consulting skills for supporting managers, project managers and employees in HSE matters Ability to create and carry out training courses on occupational safety, environment and sustainability, as well as analytical skills and experience in dealing with HSE key figures, reporting and continuous improvement Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English, other national languages are an advantage More about us Our flexible working models help you to optimize personal and professional performance and create an environment in which all employees can further develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos du poste Façonner activement l’avenir – là où la sécurité et l’innovation se rencontrent. Voici ce que vous pouvez faire : Assurer le respect des réglementations environnementales et de sécurité et des directives internes Effectuer des analyses de risques, de dangers et environnementales, y compris l'élaboration de mesures Planifier et réaliser des audits internes, des inspections et des contrôles environnementaux Enquêter sur les accidents et les événements et élaborer des mesures préventives Travailler sur des projets de développement durable et environnementaux ainsi que promouvoir la culture environnementale Créer et réaliser des formations sur des sujets liés à l'environnement et à la sécurité Conseiller et soutenir les gestionnaires et... Bonne connaissance de la législation suisse en matière de sécurité au travail et d'environnement, y compris les réglementations pertinentes (par exemple, réglementation sur les accidents majeurs, loi sur les produits chimiques, loi sur la protection de l'environnement). inspections et inspections internes, idéalement conformes à la norme ISO 14001 / ISO 45001. Nos modèles de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles et à créer un environnement dans lequel tous les collaborateurs peuvent développer davantage leurs compétences et évoluer.

jobs.title: Cluster Security Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo, ricoprirai il ruolo di esperto riconosciuto in materia di sicurezza, fornendo supporto funzionale competente in un paese o un gruppo di paesi. Sarai responsabile della ricerca, dell'analisi e dell'interpretazione delle minacce alla sicurezza emergenti che potrebbero avere un impatto su dipendenti, risorse o operazioni. Avrai un ruolo chiave nella resilienza organizzativa, nella gestione delle crisi e nell'implementazione delle strategie di sicurezza globali e regionali di Hitachi Energy. Riportando al responsabile della sicurezza regionale, gestirai progetti complessi con supervisione limitata, istruirai professionisti di livello inferiore e contribuirai a decisioni aziendali critiche attraverso approfondimenti di esperti sulla sicurezza. Come avrai un impatto Analizza le minacce emergenti alla sicurezza nazionale e internazionale e fornisci valutazioni e consulenze tempestive. Fornire supporto di sicurezza competente in tutto il paese/cluster, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza e i KPI regionali. Garantisci la conformità attraverso audit, ispezioni e monitoraggio dell'evoluzione della legislazione sulla sicurezza. Fornire consulenza esperta sulla gestione dei rischi per la sicurezza per supportare le decisioni aziendali chiave. Promuovere il miglioramento continuo e il cambiamento comportamentale attraverso iniziative di sicurezza globali e regionali. Coinvolgere le parti interessate interne ed esterne per rafforzare la consapevolezza e le prestazioni in materia di sicurezza. Guidare o supportare progetti relativi alla sicurezza, gestendo obiettivi, risorse e reporting. Coordinare la resilienza organizzativa, la risposta alle emergenze e la gestione delle crisi a livello nazionale. Il tuo backgroundMin. 5 anni di formazione avanzata e significativa esperienza come specialista della sicurezza. Comprovata esperienza nell'intelligence sulle minacce, nell'analisi dei rischi e nella gestione delle crisi. Ottima conoscenza degli standard di sicurezza, della legislazione, dei requisiti di conformità e dei processi di audit. Esperienza di coaching e consulenza ai leader su questioni di sicurezza all'interno di un'organizzazione complessa. Affari fluente in tedesco e inglese. Capacità dimostrata di gestire programmi, progetti e budget di sicurezza in modo efficace. Abile nel coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, nella comunicazione e nella collaborazione interfunzionale. Esperienza nella resilienza organizzativa, nella risposta alle emergenze e nel coordinamento della continuità aziendale. Capacità di operare in un ambiente a matrice globale e gestire responsabilità in più paesi. ca. 30% Viaggio richiesto Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de:

Leiten oder unterstützen Sie sicherheitsrelevante Projekte und verwalten Sie Ziele, Ressourcen und Berichte. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant qu'expert reconnu en matière de sécurité, fournissant un soutien fonctionnel compétent dans un pays ou un groupe de pays. Vous serez responsable de rechercher, d’analyser et d’interpréter les menaces de sécurité émergentes qui pourraient avoir un impact sur les employés, les actifs ou les opérations. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la résilience organisationnelle, la gestion des crises et la mise en œuvre des stratégies de sécurité mondiales et régionales d'Hitachi Energy. Relevant du chef de la sécurité régionale, vous gérerez des projets complexes avec une supervision limitée, coacherez des professionnels de niveau inférieur et contribuerez aux décisions commerciales critiques grâce à des informations d'experts en matière de sécurité. Comment vous aurez un impact Analysez les menaces émergentes à la sécurité nationale et internationale et fournissez des évaluations et des avis en temps opportun. Fournir un soutien de sécurité compétent dans tout le pays/cluster, en garantissant l'alignement avec les normes de sécurité régionales et les KPI. Assurer la conformité par le biais d’audits, d’inspections et de surveillance de l’évolution de la législation en matière de sécurité. Fournir des conseils d’experts en matière de gestion des risques de sécurité pour soutenir les décisions commerciales clés. Favoriser l’amélioration continue et le changement de comportement grâce à des initiatives de sécurité mondiales et régionales. Engager les parties prenantes internes et externes pour renforcer la sensibilisation et les performances en matière de sécurité. Diriger ou soutenir des projets liés à la sécurité, en gérant les objectifs, les ressources et les rapports. Coordonner la résilience organisationnelle, les interventions d’urgence et la gestion des crises au niveau national. Votre parcours Min. 5 ans de formation supérieure et expérience significative en tant que spécialiste de la sécurité. Expertise avérée en matière de renseignement sur les menaces, d’analyse des risques et de gestion de crise. Solide compréhension des normes de sécurité, de la législation, des exigences de conformité et des processus d'audit. Expérience d'encadrement et de conseil aux dirigeants sur les questions de sécurité au sein d'une organisation complexe. Affaires parlant couramment l'allemand et l'anglais. Capacité démontrée à gérer efficacement les programmes, les projets et les budgets de sécurité. Compétent en engagement des parties prenantes, en communication et en collaboration interfonctionnelle. Expérience en matière de résilience organisationnelle, d’intervention d’urgence et de coordination de la continuité des activités. Capacité à opérer dans un environnement matriciel mondial et à gérer des responsabilités dans plusieurs pays. jobs.title: R&D Electrical Validation Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   In our Product evaluation and qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, we make sure to get to the bottom of things and deliver faultless robust semiconductor chips and power modules through a rigorous qualification process. Our products are delivered to a wide range of customers worldwide for different industrial applications as well as renewable energy, traction, and eMobility. For the extension and strengthening of our testing activities, we look for a highly motivated  R&D Electrical Validation Engineer.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to development projects for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules Collaborate with R&D design, process, and product engineering teams Evaluate the performance of new platforms through electrical testing Execute and monitor various electrical tests to ensure product quality Analyze test data and provide technical recommendations Write and review test reports to communicate the key findings to project stakeholders Contribute to continuous improvement of testing activities for customer satisfaction Adhere to safety rules, environmental protection, and laboratory cleanliness and order Your background     Master's degree, or PhD in electrical engineering or a related field with a focus on semiconductor devices or power electronics Few years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in an R&D environment. Solid understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit design, and analysis. Familiarity with CAD software for electrical design (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad). Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. Proficiency in modern software tools (Python, LabView, CAD software, statistical data analysis tools) Fluency in English (written and spoken) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Opportunità Nel nostro team di valutazione e qualificazione dei prodotti presso Hitachi Energy Semiconductors a Lenzburg, ci assicuriamo di arrivare in fondo alle cose e di fornire chip e moduli semiconduttori robusti e privi di difetti attraverso un processo di qualificazione rigoroso. I nostri prodotti vengono ricevuti da un'ampia gamma di clienti in tutto il mondo per diverse applicazioni industriali, nonché per l'energia rinnovabile, la trazione e l'eMobilità. descriptionByLocale.de: In unserem Team zur Bewertung und Qualifizierung unserer Hitachi Energy Semiconductors-Produkte in Lenzburg haben wir uns auf den Weg gemacht, um alle Kosten und den Kauf von Chips und robusten Halbleitermodulen sowie die Vorteile eines strengen Qualifizierungsprozesses zu erfüllen. Unsere Produkte haben wir an eine große Auswahl an Kunden in der ganzen Welt für verschiedene industrielle Anwendungen verkauft, nicht für erneuerbare Energien, Verkehr und E-Mobilität. Um unsere Begeisterung für Tests zu steigern und zu verbessern, bin ich sehr motiviert, einen R&D-Ingenieur für elektrische Validierung zu finden. Kommen Sie zu einem Projekt – tragen Sie zu Entwicklungsprojekten für Chips und Halbleitermodule der Produktionsgeneration bei – arbeiten Sie mit einem Design-, Prozess- und Ingenieurteam für Forschung und Entwicklung zusammen – bewerten Sie die Ergebnisse neuer elektrischer Prüfverfahren – führen Sie verschiedene elektrische Tests durch und überwachen Sie sie Gewährleistung der Produktqualität - Analysieren Sie die Testdaten und führen Sie technische Beratung durch - Erstellen und Überarbeiten von Testberichten für die Kommunikation und Ergebnisse, die von den Projektbeteiligten durchgeführt werden - Tragen Sie zu einer kontinuierlich verbesserten Testaktivität bei, um die Kundenzufriedenheit zu steigern - Verbessern Sie alle Sicherheitsregeln, Umgebungsschutz, Pulizierung und Laborordnung. Hintergrund – Magistrale Auszeichnung, Auszeichnung in der Elektrotechnik oder Feld korrelieren mit einem Schwerpunkt auf eigenen Halbleiter- oder Elektrogeräten – Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Elektrotechnik, bevorzugt in einem F&E-Umfeld – Gutes Verständnis von Ihnen Elektrische Ingenieursprinzipien, Planung und Analyse von Schaltkreisen - Vertrautheit mit CAD-Software für die elektrische Planung (z. B. Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad) - Erfahrungen mit Laboranalysen wie Oszilloskopen, Multimetern und Potenziometern - Beherrschung moderner Software-Tools (Python, LabView, CAD-Software, statistische Datenanalyseinstrumente) – Englisch fließend (Schrift und Text) Unser Angebot – flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierter Mentor und ein unterstützendes und inklusives Umfeld – Sie können sich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickeln – Sie sind sich einig, dass Sie erfolgreich sind, während Sie Ihren Lebenslauf und Ihre Arbeit verrichten lavoro. descriptionByLocale.fr: Opportunités Dans notre équipe d'évaluation et de qualification des produits pressés par Hitachi Energy Semiconductors à Lenzburg, nous nous assurons de l'arrivée en arrière-plan de tous les produits et de la puce et des modules semi-conducteurs robustes et privi di difetti traversant un processus de qualification rigoureux. Nos produits viennent d'être consacrés à une vaste gamme de clients dans tout le monde pour diverses applications industrielles, non seulement pour l'énergie renouvelable, le travail et la mobilité électronique. Pour l'extension et le renforcement de nos activités de test, nous recherchons un ingénieur R&D en validation électrique très motivé. descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Sind Sie bestrebt, durch die Leitung komplexer, hochwertiger Projekte globale Wirkung zu erzielen? Kombinieren Sie strategisches Denken mit starken Umsetzungsfähigkeiten? Innerhalb der Hochspannungsproduktgruppe von Hitachi Energy gestalten wir die Zukunft der Stromübertragung und -verteilung. In unserem globalen Geschäft für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (GIS) mit Sitz in Zürich-Oerlikon liefern wir fortschrittliche Lösungen mit den höchsten Standards an Zuverlässigkeit und Innovation. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Projektmanager, der strategisch wichtige Projekte in einer globalen Matrixorganisation übernimmt. Förderung der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung zwischen den Entwicklungs-, Fertigungs- und Lieferkettenteams in einem globalen Umfeld. Tragen Sie zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen bei und gestalten Sie aktiv Best Practices innerhalb der Projektmanagementfunktion. Ihr Hintergrund. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz (7+ Jahre) bei der Leitung komplexer Projekte in einem industriellen oder technologieorientierten Umfeld, idealerweise mit internationaler Präsenz. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Stakeholder auf mehreren Ebenen zu führen, einschließlich leitender Kundenvertreter und interner Führung. Starkes kaufmännisches Verständnis mit solider Expertise in Finanzsteuerung, Risikomanagement und Vertragsabwicklung Sicherer Kommunikator mit der Fähigkeit, in einem internationalen Kontext Einfluss zu nehmen, zu verhandeln und effektiv zu präsentieren Erfahrung in der Arbeit in Matrixorganisationen und der Führung interkultureller Teams Relevante Projektmanagement-Zertifizierungen (z. B. PMP, IPMA) sind von Vorteil. Fließende Deutsch- oder Französischkenntnisse; Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse sind obligatorisch. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. How You'll Make an Impact Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Unisciti a Hitachi Energy come professionista HSE e gioca un ruolo chiave nel promuovere una forte cultura della salute, della sicurezza e dell'ambiente all'interno delle nostre attività di fabbrica a Zurigo. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con la leadership e i team interfunzionali per garantire la conformità, ridurre al minimo i rischi e migliorare continuamente le prestazioni HSE supportando operazioni sostenibili e sicure. Come avrai un impatto Garantisci la conformità alle normative HSE, alle politiche interne e agli standard Hitachi Energy in tutta la fabbrica Conduci valutazioni dei rischi, audit e ispezioni per identificare i pericoli e definire azioni di mitigazione Condurre indagini sugli incidenti e implementare misure correttive e preventive efficaci Monitorare i KPI HSE, preparare report e supportare il processo decisionale basato sui dati Fornire e coordinare sessioni di formazione HSE promuovendo consapevolezza e migliori pratiche Supportare audit interni, esterni e di certificazione, garantendo azioni di follow-up tempestive Collaborare con team interfunzionali ed esterni stakeholder per integrare l’HSE nelle operazioni quotidiane Condurre iniziative HSE e programmi di miglioramento ambientale (ad es. rifiuti, acqua, energia) Il tuo background Minimo 5 anni di esperienza HSE in un ambiente industriale o energetico Laurea in ingegneria, scienze ambientali, salute e sicurezza sul lavoro o campi simili Professionista HSE certificato secondo la legislazione svizzera (obbligatorio) Forte conoscenza degli standard ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 e delle normative svizzere HSE Comprovata esperienza nella valutazione dei rischi, nell'analisi degli incidenti e nel reporting delle prestazioni Forti capacità di comunicazione e formazione con la capacità di influenzare i comportamenti Mentalità analitica, proattiva e orientata alla soluzione con un stile di lavoro collaborativo Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese; ulteriore competenza in ergonomia o materiali pericolosi è un vantaggio. Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. How You'll Make an Impact Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit: Werden Sie HSE-Experte bei Hitachi Energy und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Förderung einer starken Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Umweltkultur in unserem Fabrikbetrieb in Zürich. Sie arbeiten eng mit Führungskräften und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Compliance sicherzustellen, Risiken zu minimieren und die HSE-Leistung kontinuierlich zu verbessern und gleichzeitig einen nachhaltigen und sicheren Betrieb zu unterstützen. Wie Sie etwas bewirken können Stellen Sie die Einhaltung von HSE-Vorschriften, internen Richtlinien und Hitachi Energy-Standards im gesamten Werk sicher. Führen Sie Risikobewertungen, Audits und Inspektionen durch, um Gefahren zu identifizieren und Maßnahmen zur Schadensbegrenzung zu definieren. Führen Sie Vorfalluntersuchungen durch und implementieren Sie wirksame Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen. Überwachen Sie HSE-KPIs, bereiten Sie Berichte vor und unterstützen Sie datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung. Durchführen und koordinieren Sie HSE-Schulungen und fördern Sie gleichzeitig das Bewusstsein und Best Practices. Unterstützen Sie interne, externe und Zertifizierungsaudits, um zeitnahe Folgemaßnahmen sicherzustellen. Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen externe Stakeholder zur Integration von HSE in den täglichen Betrieb. Leitung von HSE-Initiativen und Umweltverbesserungsprogrammen (z. B. Abfall, Wasser, Energie) Ihr Hintergrund: Mindestens 5 Jahre HSE-Erfahrung in einem Industrie- oder Energieumfeld. Abschluss in Ingenieurwesen, Umweltwissenschaften, Arbeitsschutz oder einem ähnlichen Bereich. Zertifizierter HSE-Experte nach Schweizer Gesetzgebung (obligatorisch). Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der Normen ISO 14001 und ISO 45001 sowie der Schweizer HSE-Vorschriften. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Risikobewertungen, Vorfallanalysen und Leistungsberichten. Starke Kommunikations- und Schulungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Verhaltensweisen zu beeinflussen. Analytische, proaktive und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit ein kollaborativer Arbeitsstil; fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Zusätzliche Fachkenntnisse in Ergonomie oder Gefahrstoffen sind von Vorteil. Mehr über uns. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Rejoignez Hitachi Energy en tant que professionnel HSE et jouez un rôle clé dans la promotion d'une solide culture de santé, de sécurité et d'environnement au sein de nos opérations d'usine à Zurich. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la direction et les équipes interfonctionnelles pour garantir la conformité, minimiser les risques et améliorer continuellement les performances HSE tout en soutenant des opérations durables et sûres. Comment vous aurez un impact Assurer le respect des réglementations HSE, des politiques internes et des normes Hitachi Energy dans toute l'usine Réaliser des évaluations des risques, des audits et des inspections pour identifier les dangers et définir des actions d'atténuation Mener des enquêtes sur les incidents et mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives et préventives efficaces Surveiller les KPI HSE, préparer des rapports et soutenir la prise de décision basée sur les données Organiser et coordonner des sessions de formation HSE tout en promouvant la sensibilisation et les meilleures pratiques Soutenir les audits internes, externes et de certification, en assurant des actions de suivi en temps opportun Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des parties prenantes externes pour intégrer HSE dans les opérations quotidiennes Diriger les initiatives HSE et les programmes d'amélioration environnementale (par ex. déchets, eau, énergie) Votre parcours Minimum 5 ans d'expérience HSE dans un environnement industriel ou énergétique Diplôme en ingénierie, sciences de l'environnement, santé et sécurité au travail ou dans un domaine similaire Professionnel HSE certifié selon la législation suisse (obligatoire) Solide connaissance des normes ISO 14001 et ISO 45001 et de la réglementation suisse HSE Expérience avérée en évaluation des risques, analyse d'incidents et reporting de performance Solides compétences en communication et en formation avec la capacité d'influencer les comportements Esprit analytique, proactif et orienté vers les solutions avec un style de travail collaboratif Maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais ; une expertise supplémentaire en ergonomie ou en matières dangereuses est un plus. En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity     Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact   Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities   Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us   
• We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year  Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres  Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund   Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è un leader globale nelle tecnologie energetiche e rinnovabili che consentono ai clienti delle utility e dell'industria di migliorare le proprie prestazioni riducendo al contempo l'impatto ambientale. CHSEM fornisce dispositivi a semiconduttore ad alta potenza ai clienti interni di Hitachi Energy (ad esempio HVDC, GPQSS) e ai clienti esterni. Il Senior Material Quality Engineer garantisce la qualità, la robustezza e l'affidabilità a lungo termine delle materie prime critiche utilizzate nella produzione di dispositivi a semiconduttore BiMOS presso l'impianto di fabbricazione di Lenzburg. Agendo come autorità tecnica, il ruolo gestisce in modo indipendente argomenti complessi relativi alla qualità dei materiali e dei fornitori, contribuisce alla strategia di qualità dei fornitori e supporta lo sviluppo delle capacità sia dei fornitori che del team per consentire operazioni stabili e scalabili. Come avrai un impatto Guidare l'approccio alla qualità dei materiali per le materie prime critiche utilizzate nelle operazioni BiMOS Definire e migliorare continuamente i concetti CTQ e le strategie di controllo Condurre complesse indagini sulla qualità dei materiali relative a deviazioni, resa e problemi di affidabilità Monitorare e sviluppare le prestazioni dei fornitori e garantire un'implementazione efficace delle azioni correttive Guidare le attività di qualificazione, riqualificazione e gestione delle modifiche dei materiali Supportare la produzione con competenze tecniche durante le fasi di produzione, risoluzione dei problemi e di accelerazione Guidare iniziative di miglioramento interfunzionali per migliorare la qualità, l'affidabilità e l'efficienza dei costi Agire come riferimento tecnico, supportare o tutoraggio di ingegneri e rafforzamento delle capacità di fornitori e team Il tuo background Laurea triennale o magistrale in Scienza dei materiali, chimica, fisica o un campo correlato Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella qualità dei materiali, nella qualità dei fornitori o nella produzione di semiconduttori Revisore certificato (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011 o equivalente) Forte conoscenza della qualità dei materiali, del controllo dei processi e della gestione dei rischi in un ambiente di produzione Comprovata capacità di gestire in modo indipendente problemi complessi di qualità dei materiali e dei fornitori Esperienza con metodi di qualità strutturati come 8D, Six Sigma o equivalente Maggiori informazioni su di noi
• Vi offriamo: Giorni liberi extra tra Natale e Capodanno Pasti agevolati nei luoghi con mense Sconto del 50% sui piatti principali presso i nostri frigoriferi FELFEL Sconto sugli abbonamenti in vari centri fitness Sconti su vari prodotti e servizi Interessanti vantaggi pensionistici con il nostro fondo pensione aziendale Diversità: Promozione della diversità e dell'inclusione e offerte culturali, carte di credito, benzina, ecc.)

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer - Grid Automation Control & Protection 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead new GIS installations around the globe. A technically challenging position in a multicultural environment awaits you. You can expect an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow in it. Senior as well as junior applications are welcome! How you will make an impact Managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas insulated switchgear for the voltage level of 110KV - 550KV. Responsible for the successful execution of on-site installation \/ maintenance \/ repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and in compliance with local legal requirements. Responsible for the quality of work performed on site through quality control and assessment of skills of local support staff. Conduct on-site product training on the product and during installation (optional). Coordination of local labor. Cost control of resources used and regular reporting to project management. Actively contribute to process improvements and proactively take measures to increase the efficiency of on-site activities. Your background Completed apprenticeship in the metal construction, electrical or automotive industry, or similar Basic knowledge in electrical engineering is a desirable must, further training in electrical engineering is an advantage Work experience in assembly & commissioning is an advantage Very good German and good English skills, at least B2 Willingness for national and especially international worldwide assignments with up to 90 % travel time Flexible, resilient and communicative team player Flair for pragmatic and unconventional solutions with high quality and safety standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptionByLocale.it: L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile per il mondo dopo il supporto di vendita di sistemi generatore-rompatore (GCB) e commutatori isolati a gas (GIS), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi di valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, retrofit e sostituzioni. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza globale, apprezzerete il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo una formazione pratica e versatile in Svizzera e all'estero, guiderai nuove installazioni GIS in tutto il mondo. Una posizione tecnicamente impegnativa in un ambiente multiculturale vi aspetta. Si può aspettare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere in esso. Senior così come le applicazioni junior sono benvenuti! Gestione di siti di costruzione multiculturali in tutto il mondo per interruttori isolati a gas per il livello di tensione di 110KV - 550KV. Responsabile per la riuscita dell'esecuzione dell'installazione in loco \/ manutenzione \/ riparazioni in conformità alle scadenze contrattuali e nel rispetto dei requisiti legali locali. Responsabile della qualità del lavoro svolto in loco attraverso il controllo della qualità e la valutazione delle competenze del personale di supporto locale. Condurre la formazione del prodotto in loco sul prodotto e durante l'installazione (opzionale). Coordinamento del lavoro locale. Controllo dei costi delle risorse utilizzate e reporting regolare alla gestione del progetto. Contribuire attivamente ai miglioramenti del processo e adottare proattivamente misure per aumentare l'efficienza delle attività in loco. Il tuo background Apprendistato completo nella costruzione di metalli, nell'industria elettrica o nel settore automobilistico, o simili La conoscenza di base nell'ingegneria elettrica è un must desiderabile, ulteriore formazione nell'ingegneria elettrica è un vantaggio L'esperienza di lavoro nell'assemblaggio e nella messa in servizio è un vantaggio Molto buono tedesco e buone abilità inglesi, almeno B2 Volontà per compiti nazionali e soprattutto internazionali in tutto il mondo con un tempo di viaggio flessibile, resiliente e comunicativo Un pacchetto di benefici interessanti che comprende spese fisse, di viaggio e di pasto, così come una voce nella scelta di alloggio

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, produits haute tension, est reconnue dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. L'unité de service est responsable de l'appui après vente dans le monde entier des systèmes de disjoncteurs de générateurs (GCB) et des commutateurs isolés de gaz (GIS), y compris la formation, l'installation et la mise en service, l'entretien programmé, les services à valeur ajoutée, le dépannage, les extensions, les mises à niveau et les remplacements. Le service est la clé du succès. En tant que collègue de notre équipe de service active au niveau mondial, vous apprécierez le travail indépendant, varié et axé sur la solution. Après une formation polyvalente et pratique en Suisse et à l'étranger, vous dirigerez de nouvelles installations SIG à travers le monde. Une position techniquement difficile dans un environnement multiculturel vous attend. Vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et s'y développer. Les candidatures senior et junior sont les bienvenues! jobs.title: Global Product Specialists Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'occasion Hitachi Energy est à la recherche d'un spécialiste des produits [global\/régional] pour rejoindre notre équipe innovante dans [localisation]. Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la gestion du portefeuille de produits des transformateurs, la conduite d'analyses de marché et le soutien au développement de produits de pointe. Ce poste permet non seulement d'élargir vos compétences et vos connaissances dans le secteur de l'énergie, mais aussi de contribuer à des solutions de transformation qui favorisent la durabilité et font progresser votre carrière dans un marché en évolution rapide. Comment vous ferez un impact Effectuez une analyse de marché approfondie pour identifier les tendances et évaluer leur impact sur le portefeuille Transformer. Fournir une nouvelle perspective sur la différenciation d'une technologie et d'un produit matures sur le marché en analysant les tendances du marché, en comprenant les besoins des clients et en surveillant les actions des concurrents avec une approche novatrice et créative. Évaluer les besoins techniques et effectuer des évaluations concurrentielles afin de cerner les lacunes et les possibilités d'amélioration des produits. Gérer et mettre à jour les spécifications techniques des produits existants pour assurer la compétitivité et la valeur du marché. Superviser les initiatives d'amélioration du rendement au moyen d'analyse comparative et de rétroaction sur la qualité des produits attribués. Assurer la conformité aux règlements internationaux et aux normes de l'industrie tout au long du cycle de vie des produits. Soutenir le développement de nouveaux produits en transformant les exigences du marché en intrants concrets pour la feuille de route des produits. Préparer et présenter du matériel de communication technique pour soutenir les lancements de produits et améliorer le positionnement du marché. Concevoir et offrir des séances de formation stimulantes afin d'habiliter les équipes interfonctionnelles à acquérir les connaissances les plus récentes sur les produits et les perspectives du marché. Responsabilité de veiller au respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables. Vivre les valeurs fondamentales de sécurité et d'intégrité d'Hitachi Energy, c'est-à-dire prendre la responsabilité de vos propres actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise. Diplôme d'ingénieur, d'administration des affaires, de marketing ou d'un domaine connexe. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des produits, l'analyse de marché ou un rôle semblable au sein des transformateurs ou de l'industrie de l'énergie. Une bonne compréhension technique des solutions énergétiques et des technologies industrielles pour communiquer efficacement les avantages des produits et différencier les offres. Capacité éprouvée d'effectuer des analyses de marché et des évaluations concurrentielles pour stimuler le développement de produits. Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation pour les publics techniques et non techniques. Capacité de travailler en collaboration entre les équipes interfonctionnelles et de gérer simultanément plusieurs projets
